## 2. The 7 Proprietary Slice Products (Live Demonstrations)

### 2.1 Slice3D — Spatial 3D Web Visualizer
- **Purpose**: Real-time WebGL/Three.js interactive product visualizer and spatial configuration studio running at 60fps in mobile browsers.
- **Stack**: Three.js, React Three Fiber, GLTF/GLB compression, Blender automated headless pipelines.
- **Live Demo**: https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-3d

### 2.2 SliceLeads — Autonomous B2B Prospect Discovery
- **Purpose**: High-precision B2B lead generation engine with multi-signal intent filtering, automated email verification, and company tech-stack enrichment.
- **Stack**: Node.js, Python scrapers, vector search, automated LinkedIn & Apollo enrichment.
- **Live Demo**: https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-leads

### 2.3 SliceMail — High-Deliverability Cold Outreach Infrastructure
- **Purpose**: Dedicated cold emailing framework featuring automated inbox warmup, domain rotation, SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment, and spam-trigger prevention.
- **Live Demo**: https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-mail

### 2.4 SliceInbox — AI Chief of Staff Mailbox Assistant
- **Purpose**: Self-hosted mailbox triage agent that classifies incoming emails, drafts contextual replies, detects urgent customer requests, and schedules meetings.
- **Live Demo**: https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-inbox

### 2.5 SlicePPT — Automated Executive Presentation Builder
- **Purpose**: Python and template-driven presentation generation system producing pixel-perfect 16:9 widescreen PowerPoint decks and high-DPI PDFs in brand colors (#FF5C00 / #0F172A).
- **Live Demo**: https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-ppt

### 2.6 SliceDAM — Digital Asset Vault & Legal Generator
- **Purpose**: Secure media asset repository with automatic watermark injection, metadata tagging, and programmatic contract/NDA generation.
- **Live Demo**: https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-dam

### 2.7 SliceClass — Sub-Second LMS & Video Delivery
- **Purpose**: Modern learning management and video streaming platform with DRM watermarking, interactive code exercises, and sub-second asset delivery for creative teams.
- **Live Demo**: https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-class
